inline_premium_avatar_block:
<style id="premiumExternalAvatarAssets">
/* Side Quest — Premium external avatar PNG integration.
   The PNG owns the decorative shell; app containers no longer crop or add a second ring. */
.fantasyAvatar.characterAvatar.portraitAvatar{
  background:transparent!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  overflow:visible!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
.fantasyAvatar.characterAvatar.portraitAvatar>img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  max-height:100%!important;
  display:block!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:50% 50%!important;
  transform:none!important;
  filter:none!important;
}
.fantasyAvatar.characterAvatar.portraitAvatar>.avatarAura{display:none!important}

/* Keep the artwork's own shell visible at every app size. */
#myAvatar,.profileAvatarTap,.avatarMount,.hudAvatar,.oppMiniAvatar,.bfSeatAvatar{
  overflow:visible!important;
}
#myAvatar,.profileAvatarTap,.hudAvatar,.oppMiniAvatar,.bfSeatAvatar{
  background:transparent!important;
  border-color:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
#myAvatar .portraitAvatar img,.profileAvatarTap .portraitAvatar img,
.hudAvatar .portraitAvatar img,.oppMiniAvatar .portraitAvatar img,.bfSeatAvatar .portraitAvatar img{
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center!important;
  transform:none!important;
}

/* Premium picker/profile views use a square safe zone instead of portrait cropping. */
.avatarHeroArt{
  aspect-ratio:1/1!important;
  overflow:visible!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  border-color:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
.avatarHeroArt .fantasyAvatar,.avatarChoicePortrait .fantasyAvatar{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
}
.avatarHeroArt .portraitAvatar,.avatarChoicePortrait .portraitAvatar{
  border-radius:0!important;
  overflow:visible!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
.avatarHeroArt .portraitAvatar img,.avatarChoicePortrait .portraitAvatar img{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;
  object-position:center!important;
  transform:none!important;
  filter:none!important;
}
.avatarChoicePortrait{
  overflow:visible!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  border-color:transparent!important;
}

/* Give tiny HUD emblems the maximum usable footprint without cutting frame-break details. */
.hudAvatar .fantasyAvatar,.oppMiniAvatar .fantasyAvatar,.bfSeatAvatar .fantasyAvatar,
#myAvatar .fantasyAvatar,.profileAvatarTap .fantasyAvatar{
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  overflow:visible!important;
}

</style>
